title: Indigo Ledger — Founder Quarterly
description: A Stripe-inflected quarterly update layout built on a near-white ground with deep indigo type, a single dominant KPI in a soft lavender card, and a confidentiality-tagged footer — discipline over decoration, trust over theatre.
philosophy: This template believes restraint is a form of institutional respect. It refuses to fill whitespace with decoration, centered headlines, or gratuitous animation; every element earns its position inside a locked left-origin grid. It is designed for founders and operators who communicate with investors and boards — audiences who read the number before they read the sentence. The generous left margin and single-KPI constraint are not limitations; they are the message.
goodFor: Investor quarterly business reviews anchored by a single headline metric
Board deck section dividers that introduce a new chapter with authority
SaaS all-hands slides where one KPI must carry the entire narrative
Founder-to-investor update decks requiring calm, uncluttered credibility
avoidFor: Chart-dense financial models requiring multiple simultaneous data panels
Consumer-facing pitch decks that depend on visual energy and saturated color
Image-led portfolio or case-study slides where photography must bleed to edge
Event announcements or promotional banners needing centred hierarchy
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Feels like a board memo on first impression: calm authority without ceremony, institutional weight without visual noise. Compositional rhythm is left-anchored and asymmetric — the right half of the canvas stays deliberately empty, letting negative space signal that nothing is oversold. Stripe-era restraint applied to investor communication: precision, trust, discipline. Avoid centered elements, decorative motifs, or gradients; drama comes from scale contrast against a near-silent ground.

examples.layoutNotes: Locked left-origin 12-column grid with a generous outer left margin for institutional breathing room. Title text stack occupies roughly the left seven columns in the upper-middle vertical zone; subtitle steps down through size contrast alone — no decorative rule separators needed at this tier. A single thin horizontal rule pins the top of the text block, reinforcing the left-edge discipline that runs throughout the template. Confidential-tag footer anchors bottom-left; a quarter or date stamp sits bottom-right, completing the frame without adding visual weight.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads like a precision-cut memo — one number owns the room, contained inside a cool lavender card that functions as both data vessel and editorial anchor. Surrounding copy is subordinate and explanatory, never competing; the composition is deliberately asymmetric, left-weighted with open air on the right acting as a silent argument for confidence. The mood is institutional calm, Stripe-audit-report seriousness. Avoid icon clusters, background textures, gradient washes, or any centered element — visual restraint is the trust signal.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column left-origin grid with an 8% outer left margin; the single KPI lives inside a soft lavender card spanning cols 1–4, positioned in the upper-mid zone of the canvas. Supporting label copy sits flush-left above the card in a smaller weight, and two to three tight contextual lines follow below it in cols 1–7, leaving cols 8–12 as intentional negative space. A hairline rule scores the footer zone: confidentiality tag anchors bottom-left, page number bottom-right. No decorative header band.
